component_boundaries.first_prediction_ns: Prepared model input to materialized attack probability. Includes ensemble member forwards and probability averaging for frozen ensemble targets.
component_boundaries.framework_import_ns: Imports required numerical/model framework(s), frozen architecture module(s), thread setup, and packet encoder module where required.
component_boundaries.input_preparation_ns: Supplementary diagnostic only: deterministic B=1 synthetic input construction. Not part of primary model-load or first-prediction component.
component_boundaries.model_deserialization_load_ns: Frozen model construction/deserialization, state restoration, eval mode, and frozen inference thread configuration where model-specific.
component_boundaries.parent_process_total_ns: Supplementary diagnostic: parent launch timestamp through worker process termination and stdout collection.
component_boundaries.process_spawn_to_worker_ready_ns: Parent perf_counter_ns immediately before subprocess exec to child perf_counter_ns after config parse + CPU affinity and immediately before ML/framework imports.
component_boundaries.spawn_to_first_output_ns: Parent subprocess launch timestamp to materialized first attack-probability output in child.
